Remote session configurations
Each name defines which project and agents a remote application can use.

code-review
  Project  /Users/andrewdryga/Projects/os/coop
  Access   Read-only
  Agent    codex:gpt-5.6-sol/high@personal
  Network  Filtered — only approved network traffic is allowed
    OpenAI provider endpoints
    github.com:443 · TLS

code-work
  Project  /Users/andrewdryga/Projects/os/coop
  Access   Read, edit, and commit in a separate project copy
  Agents   codex:gpt-5.6-sol/high@personal
           claude:opus/high@work
  Network  Filtered — only approved network traffic is allowed
    OpenAI and Anthropic provider endpoints
    github.com:443 · TLS
    registry.npmjs.org:443 · TLS

Agents are tried in order when one reaches its usage limit.

Edit configurations: ~/.config/coop/session-policies.yaml
